doc.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022

title: New Year's Eve and goodbyes
summary: Closing jokes about Amateur Drunk Night and thanks.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well thank you so much for your time and you’ve been generous with it. And I wish you the best in your upcoming gigs and may the New Year’s Eve horns be scarce.
Yeah amen. Amen. They’ll still be there though. I used to call it Amateur Drunk Night.
People who never really drank more than one glass of wine, now it’s obligatory to get as foolish as you can be.
Yeah they didn’t know how to be drunks.
Thank you very much. I’m going to pause here and we’ll say our good-byes.
